claim.reason: West_view.png and South_view.png both draw this door's frame reaching from the ground line up to a head clearly below the F2 floor line, with no separate dimensioned chain (the nearby 600/900/1500 chain on South_view.png was assigned to the adjacent small window, not this door). unresolved: No printed dimension labels the door height directly; the value rests on matching the drawn frame's pixel extent against the calibrated roof/ground/floor-line anchors, not a labelled chain.
